package main
import "fmt"
import "bufio"
import "os"
func main() {
    leitor := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
    var palv1, palv2 string //palavra a, palavra b
    fmt.Fscanln(leitor, &palv1)
    fmt.Fscan(leitor, &palv2)

    A := []rune(palv1)
    B := []rune(palv2)

    for len(A) > 0 && len(B) > 0 && A[len(A) - 1] == B[0] {
        A = A[:len(A)-1]
        B = B[1:]
    }
    result := append(A, B...)
    fmt.Println(string(result))
}
